title: THE LOST KIND: Heart of the Lost
synopsis: The war for two worlds has begun. Raised by monsters, Ryan ventured into the human kingdom in search of his lost father — but the journey has become something far greater, as dark secrets, ancient powers, and the fragile boundary between humans and monsters all converge.
